# 'Todudaiya Seviyan', the first hymn

`sam-todudaiya` | Thirugnana Sambandar | 1 songs

With the milk still on his lips the child points to Shiva and sings the first Tevaram hymn, beginning 'Todudaiya Seviyan'. Song 776 names it.
